appearance_facts.fact: The pie chart is titled 'Global Energy Consumption by Source'.
The pie chart is divided into four colored segments.
The segment labeled 'Nuclear (40%)' is colored light yellow.
The segment labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' is colored orange.
The segment labeled 'Hydroelectric (25%)' is colored red.
The segment labeled 'Renewables (20%)' is colored orange-red.
The 'Nuclear (40%)' segment is the largest by visual area.
The 'Hydroelectric (25%)' segment is the second largest by visual area.

printed_facts.fact: The 'Fossil Fuels' segment is labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)'.

public_definitions: The goal is to review the global energy mix dashboard, identify the largest global energy consumption source category, then route that source record to priority source monitoring for this reporting cycle.
The comparison scope is the global energy consumption source categories shown in the pie chart.
The rules are to use the dashboard to determine the largest category and route that specific source record to priority source monitoring.
